# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary featuring over 300,000 word definitions, language resources, and educational tools for learners of all ages.

Merriam-Webster provides comprehensive dictionary services including the renowned Collegiate Dictionary, Word of the Day features, slang references, and interactive word games. The site offers resources across multiple platforms including iOS, Android, and web, serving students, word game enthusiasts, and language learners with authoritative definitions and vocabulary tools.

## Key Topics

- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary
- Word of the Day
- Scrabble and word games
- Language learning
- Vocabulary building
- Slang and modern usage
- Dictionary apps (iOS, Android)
- Word Finder tools
- Student dictionaries
- Quordle and Blossom games
- Etymology and Latin roots
- New words and definitions
- Reference books

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage featuring 300,000+ word definitions, games, and daily features
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Collegiate Dictionary Twelfth Edition product information and features
- [Slang Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Slang dictionary covering trending words, Gen Z phrases, and emojis

## Word Games and Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble and word game solver tool for finding matching words
- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile apps including dictionary, Scrabble, and word game downloads

## Daily Features and Learning

- [Word of the Day Calendar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary feature with podcast, email, and social media options
- [Student Dictionary for Kids](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Student dictionary and educational games designed for young learners
